Iran-related Designations; Updates to Certain Iran-related Listings; Publication of Iran-related OFAC Alert; Issuance of Amended Venezuela-related General License and Frequently Asked Question
The Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is publishing an Iran-related Alert
, "Iranian Shadow Fleet Reliance on False Flags for Sanctions Evasion."
Additionally, OFAC is issuing Venezuela-related General License 5AA

en_body:
Settlement Agreement between the U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control and Extreme Networks, Inc.
The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) today announced an $1,529,685 settlement with Extreme Networks, Inc. ("Extreme"), a North Carolina headquartered cloud networking solutions provider. Between September 2018 and March 2022, Extreme exported networking equipment and related services on nine occasions from the United States to Joint Stock Company (JSC) Moskovskiy Mashinostroitelniy Zavod Avangard, a Russian defense manufacturer that is blocked by operation of law and majority owned by designated JSC Concern Almaz Antey. The settlement amount reflects OFAC's determination that these apparent violations were voluntarily self-disclosed and egregious.
For more information, please visit the following Enforcement Release

Protecting American Intellectual Property Act of 2022 (PAIPA) Designations; Issuance of Associated General Licenses
The Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is issuing Protecting American Intellectual Property Act of 2022 (PAIPA) General License 1
, "Transactions Authorized Pursuant to the Cyber-Related Sanctions Regulations;" and Protecting American Intellectual Property Act of 2022 (PAIPA) General License 2
, "Authorizing the Wind Down of Transactions Involving Certain Entities Blocked on October 19, 2026."
OFAC has also made the following changes to its Non-SDN Menu Based Sanctions List (NS-MBS List).
NON-SDN Menu-Based SANCTIONS LIST UPDATE
